basic_info.description: Enjoy living in this quiet one-bedroom Penthouse home. Featuring an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living room enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light and showcase vibrant city views. The unit has hardwood floors in the living area and soft carpet in the bedroom, and boasts a high-end Bosch washer/dryer and abundant storage throughout the home,including closets in the bedroom with built-in organizers. The en-suite bath has a tub with shower over and tile floors and walls. The home comes with a one-car parking space included. 829 Folsom St offers 24-hour attendants, deeded parking, a club room with a kitchen, and a rooftop terrace with panoramic views. Ideally situated near the FiDi, Downtown, Yerba Buena Gardens, SFMOMA, and shopping, with Whole Foods and Target just around the corner. Many restaurants and coffee shops walking distance. Commuting is effortless with the brand new Muni station located across the street, BART, Caltrain, 101/280, Bay Bridge access, and the new central subway station, which is steps away.
